home.tagline: A family table by the sea — Cala San Vicente, since 2016

heritage.subtitle: of Dutch family adventure on a Spanish island

quote.body: To share your food and spend time with your loved ones while enjoying the beach and sea views — that's our idea of paradise.

act3.headline: Where the road runs out and the sea begins
act3.body: Cala San Vicente sits in the far north of Ibiza, beyond the last switchback. The road ends here. From the restaurant terrace, the cove opens onto turquoise water and the cliffs of Es Moli, untouched.

act4.headline: Where stories settle and the table waits
act4.body: Our menu, our kitchen, our home — you've arrived.

act5.headline: Modern, organic, hyper-local
act5.intro: Five signatures from the Mediterranean coast and beyond, prepared with sourcing from our zero-km farm and trusted partners across Spain and Italy.

act5b.headline: Five places, one table
act5b.intro: Our pantry is a quiet map of the Mediterranean — Galician beef, our own zero-km farm five minutes from the kitchen, buffalo mozzarella from a single dairy outside Naples, mezze that travels from Beirut, and the catch our captain lands at the cove that morning.

act6.headline: Anchor your boat — we deliver to the cove
act6.body: Captains, sail in. Drop anchor at Cala San Vicente, message us with your VHF or WhatsApp, and our skiff brings the table to you. Lunch, drinks, paella for the whole crew — served on deck or in the sand.
act6.col1Body: On the deck or under the pines. Lunch from 12:30, dinner from 19:00, last booking at 22:00.
act6.col2Body: Drop anchor at Cala San Vicente, ping us on VHF 09 or WhatsApp +34 971 334 273, our skiff comes out within fifteen minutes.

r1.body: An aquarium floor under your feet, a cove view that softens with the sun. The food kept up — every plate read as the place itself.

r2.body: We arrived by boat for lunch. Two hours later we were still at the table, our skipper was at the bar, and nobody seemed to want to leave.

r3.body: The Friesian Tomahawk for two is the most honest steak I've eaten in Ibiza. The salsa verde — pure cove, pure sea.

act7.headline: We'll keep your table waiting
act7.body: Whether you arrive by car, by boat, or by long lazy walk along the cliffs — we'll be at the corner of the deck, watching the cove turn from turquoise to gold. Welcome home.
act7.address: Calle del Calo 12, Cala San Vicente, Eivissa

menu.headline: Plates born of place
menu.intro: Six small editorial chapters — tapas, starters, mains, salads, desserts, drinks. Hyper-local where we can, sourced with intent everywhere else.

callout.label: Reserve
callout.title: Tables fill fast in season
callout.body: We accept reservations from 12:30 to 23:00. For groups over six, please contact us directly so we can prepare the right corner of the deck.

about.headline: Forty years of Dutch curiosity on a Spanish island
about.intro: From a single van in Figueretes to a beachfront table at the cove — the story of a family that fell in love with Ibiza, learned its kitchens, and stayed.

1985.title: A van, a dog, an idea
1985.body: Tom and Maria Zandwijk arrive in Figueretes with a Volkswagen Bus, a black Labrador called Otto, and the conviction that food can be both Dutch in discipline and Spanish in soul.

2005.title: On the Beach
2005.body: After two decades of seasonal kitchens across the island, the family opens On the Beach in Cala San Vicente — the first table where the menu was as small as the cove itself.

2016.title: The Boat House
2016.body: A renovated boathouse on the same beach, larger crew, the same idea: share food with people you love while the sea decides the time of day.

2025.title: The cove farm
2025.body: Our zero-km farm opens behind the dunes — tomatoes, herbs, leaves and edible flowers walk to the kitchen the same morning.

about.chefBio: Trained in Amsterdam, Madrid and Bangkok, Lieke runs the kitchen with her brother Sven on the pass. Her food reads like a postcard: a paella that nods to Valencia but speaks Mediterranean Ibiza, a curry that travels from Bangkok back to the cove.

gallery.headline: Forty seasons in colour
gallery.intro: Plates, faces, sky, salt. A loose archive of the cove and the table — updated every spring.

contact.headline: Find us, write us, drop anchor
contact.intro: We answer email within the day. For same-day reservations, please call directly — the line is open from 11:00.

footer.tagline: A family table by the sea — Cala San Vicente, since 2016.
